# Nebo Blyzhche

> Astrophotography from a city balcony in Ukraine: nebulae, galaxies and clusters shot with a DWARF Mini smart telescope. A challenge to capture everything visible from here, and the Messier catalogue.

Personal astrophotography site by Kostia: deep-sky objects shot with a DWARF Mini smart telescope from a city balcony in Ukraine (only the eastern half of the sky is visible, light-polluted city sky). The site is rebuilt automatically after each night of shooting. Challenge: 21 of 65 objects captured, 48 nights, 149 h of deep-sky light. Messier: 15 of 100 reachable captured. Last update: 2026-10-17. All images are the author's own; the Telegram channel is in Ukrainian.

## Main pages

- [Home (English)](https://tepliyk.github.io/en/): challenge progress, gallery, Messier map, Solar System
- [Home (Ukrainian)](https://tepliyk.github.io/): original version
